findings.evidence: template/scripts/finish_task.py:522–534 sets advanced_from whenever branch != main_branch, including when integration main already equals the task branch. If the first invocation merges successfully but project_publish fails, retrying performs an already-up-to-date merge and then calls record_integration_advance with identical heads. template/scripts/delegation_containment.py:373–374 rejects that call. The exception prevents subsequent completion bookkeeping, and further retries encounter the same failure.
findings.summary: Retrying direct publication after a failed push now fails even when the retry successfully publishes.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/delegation_containment.py:434 reads the complete append-only log into memory, and lines 438 onward parse every historical receipt. Time filtering happens only afterward in _receipt_chain. openspec/changes/claude-external-advance/design.md states 'Receipt log growth: append-only small lines; bounded reading by time window,' but no bounded reading or retention mechanism is implemented.
findings.summary: Receipt processing grows with the entire lifetime of the integration checkout despite the documented bounded-reading mitigation.
